note: No 3D source: the mesh is built from parameters (scripts/crate_params.json) by scripts/crate_build.py. The concept collage is a read-only visual reference; it stays where it is (committed) and is not copied. crate_build.py verifies its sha256 before the run. No Tripo/SYNTX operation: 0 credits, no ledger entry.

sources.kind: imagegen concept collage (art/imagegen/mvp-v1, commit 23368eea): front, side and 3/4 view on grey
sources.used_for: proportions (X brace on the front, 4 horizontal side planks, corner posts with iron studs, planked top) and colour sampling (median sRGB: side planks 75,68,62; front X board 84,74,67; stud highlight ~115,109,105)
sources.not_used_for: no tracing, projection or texture transfer

deviations_from_reference: Iron corner caps (8) instead of bare post ends: the task brief for style B asks for iron-bound corners; the concept shows only iron studs on the posts. The caps also mark the corners from the top-down game camera.
X brace on the back as well as the front (concept shows one X face): the crate reads the same after a 180 deg turn.
Top: 4 boards along the front-back axis, inset flush with the wall tops; no separate top battens.
